BeepBox 4.2.2
https://github.com/johnnesky/beepbox
commit 3a88cd674149c8c15b7f59064db07c082f9eb152
tag v4.2.2

vendor/beepbox_editor.min.js is the official editor IIFE
(scripts/compile_editor.sh — rollup format iife, name beepbox, then terser).
Never fetched at runtime. Rebuild with:

  node apps/beepbox/vendor.mjs

MIT, John Nesky and contributing authors. The notice rides inside
the GIF as COPYING-beepbox.txt.

The editor's MP3 path loads lamejs from jsdelivr — shim.js blocks that
script. WAV, MIDI and JSON export stay local. URL shorteners (is.gd /
tinyurl) and "View in Song Player" (a navigation off this page) are
removed from the File menu.

A first-run song is vendor/seed.json, generated from the same Song
class during vendor.mjs so it round-trips.
